profile.headline: Front End Web Developer at BILL | Webflow Expert
profile.summary:
Front-End Web Developer specializing in Webflow development, Client-First architecture, scalable component systems, and high-performance marketing websites.

Experienced in building and maintaining enterprise-level Webflow sites with 100+ pages, CMS-driven architectures, and reusable design systems using the Client-First methodology to create scalable, organized, and easy-to-maintain builds.

Skilled in Webflow, JavaScript, GSAP, Shopify Liquid, Finsweet Attributes, and responsive UI development. Passionate about creating clean user experiences, optimizing site performance, and bridging the gap between design and development.

Currently focused on component-driven development, scalable CMS structures, advanced interactions/animations, and improving workflows for fast-moving teams.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Built scalable, component-driven frontend experiences for BILL’s marketing ecosystem using Webflow, custom code, and CMS architecture.

* Developed reusable Webflow components and modular page-building systems to improve scalability and team efficiency
* Built and maintained CMS-driven landing pages and marketing experiences across the BILL website
* Collaborated cross-functionally with design, marketing, and stakeholders to launch responsive, accessible, and high-performing web experiences
* Implemented custom frontend functionality using JavaScript, GSAP, and Finsweet Attributes
* Helped improve internal design system standards and streamline content editing workflows
* Optimized site performance, responsiveness, and overall user experience across multiple page templates and campaigns

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
- Worked closely with Griffo House to build multiple websites for a variety of clients.
- Developed on WebFlow and Shopify platforms using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery and Liquid.
- Ensured Desktop and Responsive Mobile design to be pixel perfect.
- Integrated custom animations.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
- Worked closely to build multiple websites for various clients.
- Developed using WebFlow and Shopify platforms with HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery and Liquid.
- Used CMS collections to create more dynamic elements on the project.
- Utilized BugHerd to get direct client request to implement into web application.
- Ensured full responsiveness across all devices.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
- Worked closely with Bondir to develop a website for their client ZombieBox.
- Developed in Squarespace platform. Custom coded 90% of the site and used 10% of
Squarespace’s native elements.
- Used HTML, CSS, JavaScript and JQuery to bypass Squarespace limitations. Including custom
accordion, modal, carousel and DOM manipulation.
- Ensured all mobile, tablet and desktop media queries were aligned to Figma designs.

positions.title: Student
positions.description: Full Stack Software Engineering Program, focused on common best practices in object-oriented-programming, MVC frameworks, data modeling, and test-driven development
